Publication statement: [Philadelphia, Pa.?] : Tackabury, Rowley & Co., c1892.

Relief shown by hachures. Cadastral map showing drainage, section lines and numbers, land ownership, landowners' names, school houses, roads, rail roads, etc. "Copyright 1892 by E. Frank Peterson." Includes list of subdivisions of Union County, insets of "Plat of the City of Elk Point" and "South part of Big Sioux Township," business directory, and ill. of buildings.
